name: Historical site modifiers
description: Descriptive historical variations compatible with specific location generators

fields.name: Local Center
fields.description: The place is the community’s most important and concentrates resources, reputation, and local conflict.

fields.name: National Institution
fields.description: The place influences the whole country and benefits from exceptional political protection.

fields.name: Continental Site
fields.description: The place is unique on the continent and attracts experts, pilgrims, spies, and foreign powers.

fields.name: Closed After an Incident
fields.description: Official access is forbidden during an inquiry, contamination, or crisis that authorities minimize.

fields.name: Under Renovation
fields.description: Part of the place is inaccessible while workers, scaffolding, and old plans create new routes.
